b: People say that philosophers have been working on the same questions for thousands of years. True, we are persistent—thanks for noticing! But it’s also the case that philosophers are often working on new questions, ones that did not exist thousands or hundreds of years ago, or even decades ago. We’re inventive, too!
Today is World Philosophy Day. To mark the occasion, I thought it would be a good idea to let people know what philosophers are asking about today.
For that, I’ll need your help.
Philosophers, please take a moment to write down, in a comment on this post, one question you are currently working on. (Yes, just one.)

It would also help if you shared the post and encouraged other philosophers to comment with a question they’re working on. The result could be a picture of what philosophers are thinking about today, parts of which perhaps catch the attention of people who otherwise might have not realized they are interested in what philosophers are up to.

(Some readers may recall that I’ve posted this query several years ago. Unfortunately, the previous comments appear to have been lost, either in the recent hack or the resultant upgrade. I only recently noticed this, and am looking into whether they’re recoverable.)
